Madeleine is a lecturer at Queen Mary University of London and a member of the Centre for Biodiversity and Sustainability. She studies the behavioural, physiological and computational ecology of wild bees, with a focus on how they respond to climate change.

Her work combines field thermal physiology and behavioural ecology of ground-nesting bees with specimen- and image-based macroecology. Before starting her lab, she spent three years as a postdoc in specimen digitisation, developing deep learning pipelines and geometric morphometric approaches for extracting traits from museum specimens.
